methods.name: file_search.msearch
methods.description: Queried the user-supplied files with multiple semantically-rich search strings (e.g., “EvidencePack schema methods array”) to locate any explicit definition of the EvidencePack schema so the response could conform to it.

methods.name: content inspection & inference
methods.description: Manually inspected the returned PDF excerpts to confirm they did not contain the schema; then inferred the minimal compliant structure (top-level “methods” array with objects that have at least “name” and “description” fields) and populated it with the analytical steps used.
